title: Internal: ATM Dispute Special Procedures
summary: This document details special dispute procedures for ATM transactions, split by Rho-Bank owned ATMs vs third-party ATMs. It specifies cash discrepancy, deposit not credited (get_atm_deposit_images_8473; up to 45 days), and retained card (retrieve from branch within 3 business days), plus third-party chargeback submission (up to 90 days), provisional credit within 10 business days, and affidavit rules for disputes over $200 (10 business days; possible denial; false affidavit is a federal offense).
faqs: What are the steps for an ATM cash discrepancy at a Rho-Bank branded ATM, and when is provisional credit issued?
How do we handle an ATM “deposit not credited” dispute, including the tool used and the 45-day timeline?
If an ATM retained the card at a Rho-Bank ATM, what is the process and what options does the customer have within 3 business days?
For third-party ATM disputes (Allpoint, bank partners, independent ATMs), do we submit a chargeback, what is the investigation timeline, and how fast must provisional credit be provided?
When is an Electronic Fund Transfer Error Resolution Affidavit required (e.g., disputes over $200), how is it sent, what is the 10-business-day deadline, and what happens if it’s not returned?
If the journal shows the correct cash amount at a Rho-Bank ATM, can the claim be validated and what options remain for the customer?
keywords: provisional credit (no waiting period for Rho-Bank ATM; within 10 business days for third-party)
card retained (retrieve from branch within 3 business days)
Third-party ATM chargeback submission to owner/network
ATM affidavit requirement (Electronic Fund Transfer Error Resolution Affidavit)
false affidavit is a federal offense
